name: joust
description: JOUST — an audio-first flying duel. Flap to stay up, and win a collision by being the higher rider. Every rider's altitude relative to yours IS its pitch, so a threat above you sings higher than the reference tone and prey below you sings lower. Kill one and it drops an egg that falls, ticks, and hatches into something worse.

scripts.test: node tools/sim.js && gulp build --debug && node tools/boot.js && gulp build
